notes: New: capacity planning - switch the workload heatmap between Tasks and Hours; set hours per day, and any day booked above capacity turns red with an Overbooked badge (tasks without an estimate count as 1 hour)
New: agenda - the next 10 days of deadlines grouped by day on the Home page; tap a day to drill into its tasks

New: calendar export - Add to calendar downloads an .ics file (all-day deadlines with a reminder at 9am the day before) for all open tasks, or for exactly the list open in a drill-down sheet; works with Google, Outlook and Apple Calendar

New: reminders - opt-in daily digest of tasks due today and overdue as a browser notification (or an in-app banner if notifications are blocked); it runs while MISphere is open and is shown once per change
New: task comments - every row in a drill-down sheet has a comment thread (latest three shown, 300 characters each, author and date) and a comment count
Your data is kept: comments are one new optional field on a task; capacity and reminder preferences are stored separately on this device; existing tasks, members and backups load exactly as before

New: agenda - the next 10 days of deadlines grouped by day on the Home page; tap a day to drill into its tasks

history.title: Drill-down for the Command center
n: New: drill-down - tap Open, Overdue, Due in 48h, At risk or Estimated effort in the Command center, a heatmap cell (member × day) or a member name to open a side sheet with the exact tasks behind the number (a bottom sheet on phones)

New: inside the sheet - filter by task, owner or module; sort by deadline, priority, progress, owner or effort; reassign a task from a menu, move its deadline by one day (original deadline and Moved badge are kept) or jump to it in Tasks; the headline updates live with the count, hours and overdue
New: take the list with you - Copy list for chat or email and Download CSV (opens cleanly in Excel; cells that start with = + - or @ are neutralised)
Improved: keyboard and screen-reader support - heatmap cells and tiles are buttons reachable with Tab, Enter and Space, Esc closes the sheet, Tab stays inside it and focus returns to where you were
Your data is kept: reassigning and moving deadlines use the same task fields as the Tasks page; no new stored fields or format changes

history.title: Command center reliability and quick capture accuracy
n: Fixed: the Command center showed nothing (and Quick capture looked unresponsive on the Home page) when any member was marked On leave - it now renders for every team and shows an “On leave” badge

Fixed: Quick capture read a name such as “Tom” as tomorrow and a word such as “sats” as Saturday; only today, tomorrow, tmr, full or 3-letter weekday names, +3d, 15 nov and dates are treated as deadlines
Improved: Quick capture warns when an @name or #module matches nobody, ignores a double Enter, returns focus to where you were on close and keeps Tab inside the dialog
Improved: workload heatmap cells have tooltips (member · day · number of tasks), members on leave are excluded from the capacity hint, and the panel stays hidden on an empty workspace
Improved: a problem inside the panel is now written to the browser console instead of failing silently
Your data is kept: no stored fields or formats changed

history.title: Command Center: quick capture, workload heatmap and delivery radar
n: New: Quick capture - press N (or the + button) and type a task in one line, e.g. “Send stock report @ali tomorrow !high #inventory 2h”; owner, deadline (today, tomorrow, fri, +3d, 15 nov), priority, module and estimate are understood, with a live preview before you press Enter (Shift+Enter keeps it open for the next task)
New: Command center on the Home page - open, overdue, due-in-48h, at-risk and estimated-effort tiles at a glance
New: Workload heatmap - every member against the next 10 days of deadlines plus Late and Later, with Overloaded / Busy / Balanced badges and a hint about who has capacity

New: Delivery radar - open tasks that are overdue, due within a day with low progress, or behind the expected pace are ranked by risk; move a deadline by one day or open the task in one tap (the original deadline and the Moved badge are kept)
Improved: glass tiles, staggered fade-in and press feedback on the new panels; reduced-motion and print are respected
Your data is kept: no new stored fields and no format change - existing tasks, members, settings and backups load exactly as before

history.title: Aligned task form and completion details
n: New: task form aligned to one grid - equal-height fields, labels on one baseline, date, select and number inputs the same size, a tidy quick-deadline row and a full-width Add task button on phones; 3 / 2 / 1 column layouts at tablet and phone widths

New: completion details redesigned - every finished task shows an aligned status chip (Done date · days early or late) with a colour dot, a note block with an accent bar for the closing note and a green edge on the card

Improved: task rows - avatar, title, chips and controls share one top line; every chip has the same height; status, progress and action buttons line up in one right-hand column, and on phones the controls drop to a full-width row
Improved: Close task sheet and Edit task completion fields - equal-height fact tiles, aligned labels and inputs, a separated action row with full-width buttons on small screens
Your data is kept: layout and styling only - no task, member, settings or backup data changes

history.title: Executive professional theme and detailing
n: New: Executive colour combo (royal blue, deep teal, brass) - a restrained corporate palette tuned for light and dark, available first in the colour picker
New: professional surface system - slate-navy neutrals, hairline borders, two-level depth shadows and calmer status colours (green, amber, red, cyan) with higher text contrast

Improved: detailing - tabular lining numerals on figures and tables, uppercase table headers, tighter heading tracking, row hover tint, refined primary buttons, input hover and clear keyboard focus rings, thin themed scrollbars
Improved: smoother, consistent transitions on cards, buttons and fields (disabled when reduced motion is on); print output stays flat
Housekeeping: unrelated DashView files (js/, css/reports-hub.css, test/) removed again so they are not published
Your data is kept: styling only - no task, member, settings or backup data changes

history.title: Release notes, update centre and settings overview
n: New: release notes you can open - every version in Settings → System & about → Updates is a card (version, headline, weekday and date, type) that opens a full release sheet with What's new, Improved, Fixed and Data & safety sections, a filter, previous / next navigation, Expand all and Copy notes

New: a proper update message - the Software Update sheet shows installed → new version, the release headline and date, counts (new / improved / fixed), the top highlights and, when you are several versions behind, a combined summary of every release you missed; the list scrolls and never runs off the screen

New: searchable, filterable version history - filter by All, New, Improved, Fixed or Data & safety, grouped by month, with the exact day each version was released and when it was installed or first opened on this device
New: update preferences - automatic checks on / off, check frequency, how long “Remind me later” waits and whether What's New opens after updating, plus Copy diagnostics for support

New: settings overview - workspace, version and update status, data protection, sync and storage at a glance (tap a tile to jump to its section), a desktop side navigation with section descriptions, and marks on sections and fields that have unsaved changes
Improved: roomier settings panels - icon headers, clearer rows, a one-column layout on phones, and a short update summary in Settings instead of a wall of text
Fixed: update message was one unbroken block - it listed every note together and could not be scrolled on small screens
Fixed: wrong version shown in About and in exported settings - both showed 11.1.0 instead of the installed version
Fixed: missing install history entries - versions loaded by a normal reload (not through the updater) were never recorded; each version is now logged the first time it runs
Your data is kept: no task, member or backup data changes; update preferences are stored separately on this device

history.title: Deadline-aware task closing
n: New: closing a task is now judged against its deadline - when a task is overdue (or not started yet) a “Close task” sheet asks which day the work was really finished, with quick buttons (Today, Yesterday, On the deadline day) and a live verdict such as “On time - 2 days before the deadline” or “Late - 3 days after the deadline (1 working day)”, plus the points it will earn and an optional closing note; work finished on time is no longer booked as late just because it was closed later

New: the same close flow runs everywhere a task can be finished - the status menu, the progress slider at 100%, board buttons and drag-and-drop, bulk “Done” (one date for all selected tasks, with a per-task verdict) and the Done button in Daily notes; every close can be undone for a few seconds, and on-time closes on a normal day stay one tap
New: Settings → General → Closing tasks - choose when MISphere asks for the completion date: only when overdue or not started (default), every time, or never (always today)

New: every finished task shows how far it was from its deadline - “Done 2 Nov · 2d early”, “on deadline day” or “1d late” on the list and the board (hover for the working days), with the closing note shown under the task
New: Edit task has “Completed on” and “Closing note” for finished tasks with a live on-time / late line, and tells you when a change flips the task between on time and late

Improved: Insights splits on-time work into early and deadline-day finishes and reports the average days before or after the deadline; the view CSV, week CSV, Excel export and JSON report get a “Days vs deadline” column, and the Excel export / import carries the closing note (import still ignores the extra columns)
Fixed: a task closed before its planned start now moves its start to the completion day instead of finishing before it began

Fixed: bulk “Postpone / Set to today” could place the deadline before the start date, changed finished tasks and never counted as a move; it now keeps the deadline on or after the start, skips finished tasks and records the move
Fixed: repeating and duplicated tasks no longer inherit the “Moved” badge and original deadline of the task they came from
Fixed: reopening a task clears its completion date and closing note; finished tasks saved with a completion before their start or in the future are repaired on load
Housekeeping: the unrelated DashView files (js/, css/reports-hub.css, test/) are removed again so they are not published with the site
Your data is kept: one optional field (closing note) and one setting are new; existing tasks, members and backups load exactly as before

history.title: Task ageing and open-time tracking
n: New: every task now says how long it has been open - list view shows “Open 4 days · Day 4 of 5” (or “over plan”), finished tasks show “Took 3 days”, tasks that have not started yet show “Starts in 2 days”; hover for the start date, working days and plan
New: ageing alerts - open tasks older than a limit you set (Settings → Targets, default 5 days) are flagged amber, overdue ones red; a one-tap “aging” chip and a new “Aging tasks” filter list them

Improved: board cards show the open age, the start-to-deadline range on hover and a ↻ mark when the deadline moved; each board column shows its average open age (or average days to close) and how many tasks are aging
Improved: list view day headings summarise the day (tasks · open · overdue); the overview line shows the average open age; new sorts “Longest open” and “Start date”
New: deleting a task can be undone for 8 seconds; the status and progress controls on every row now have screen-reader labels
New: “Days open” column in the view CSV, the week CSV report and the Excel export (import ignores it, so exports can still be imported)
Your data is not changed by this update: no new stored fields; the ageing limit is a new setting with a safe default

history.title: Start dates and safer updates
n: New: every task now has an editable start date and deadline - set them when adding a task and change either one later from Edit; quick buttons (same day, +1 day, +3 days, +1 week, +2 weeks) and a live duration line show the span; a task can be scheduled for a future day and appears on that day

New: clearer task display - each task shows its start to deadline range with a status badge (Starts tomorrow, Due today, 3d overdue) and a Moved badge when its deadline was changed; board cards show future start dates; the CSV export includes Start date
New: Excel import also reads a Start date / Start column (the existing Date column still works)

Safer updates: before an update installs, a restore point is saved automatically; the update is only applied once the new version is confirmed live on the server (no more update loops while the host is still publishing); the restore points are no longer wiped on startup

Safer data: saved data now carries a format version; older data is upgraded automatically and an untouched copy is kept first (it also appears under Data safety restore points); unreadable data is preserved instead of being overwritten by an empty workspace; fields added by newer versions are never dropped
Fixed: tasks with a missing or invalid date, status, priority or progress are repaired on load instead of breaking the page; a finished task with no completion date is no longer counted as late
Fixed: the recovery prompt after a faulty session did nothing - it now points you to your restore points
Housekeeping: removed unrelated DashView files (js/, css/reports-hub.css, test/) that were published with the site but never used by MISphere

history.title: iOS type system and update repair
n: New: iOS type system everywhere - SF Pro Display and SF Pro Text on iPhone, iPad and Mac, bundled Inter variable (the closest match) on Windows, Android and Linux; dashboard, landing page, charts, dialogs and form fields now share one font stack

New: bolder, clearer weight scale across the whole theme - body 500, labels and buttons 600, headings 700-800, KPI figures 800 with tabular numbers; tight iOS tracking on large titles, calmer tracking on small text
Improved: landing page headings, cards and stats follow the same iOS type and weights as the dashboard (Bricolage Grotesque and Instrument Sans are no longer drawn)

Fixed: the Software Update prompt never appeared - version.json had been replaced by another app's file (2.30.1, lower than 11.6.0); the update feed is restored with MISphere's full history and 11.7.0

Fixed: offline install - sw.js was another app's worker listing 60+ files that do not exist, so it could never install; rebuilt for MISphere (each file cached on its own, version.json always read fresh, old caches cleaned)
Housekeeping: README badge, package.json, desktop app version and CHANGELOG aligned to 11.7.0

history.title: iOS typography and edge blur
n: iOS typography: SF Pro on Apple devices, bundled Inter (the closest match) everywhere else, tighter headings and smoother text rendering
Proper iOS-style blur: progressive edge blur under the top and bottom bars plus frosted header and tab bar

history.title: Header blur refinement
n: Clean blur on the header and tab bar only: content scrolls softly behind them, colours stay solid and clear

history.title: Clearer colour and contrast
n: Clear colour, no haze: removed the smoky background glow, the blurred top/bottom edge fade and frosted glass cards; surfaces are now solid with crisp borders
Truer, more saturated tones: stronger text contrast, vivid status colours, solid tinted KPI icons and status tiles, member cards with a clean colour bar, clear white input fields

history.title: Landing-page look and slim command header
n: Workspace now follows the landing page: new default “MISphere” colour combo (indigo, violet, cyan), Bricolage Grotesque headings, Instrument Sans body, crisp white cards in light mode

Slim two-row command header: brand, search, module, New task, data-safety, theme and profile on top; week, office-day progress and task pulse below. GitHub status moved into the shield sheet, home link into the brand tile, leader card stays on the Home page
Home: getting-started checklist for empty workspaces, cleaner section titles, balanced KPI grid (two columns on phones)

history.title: Smoother theme switching
n: Smooth theme switch: light/dark and colour-combo changes now cross-fade as one (no more background fading while cards flip instantly); dark mode no longer flashes light on startup
Colour sync: accent picker swatches now match the applied colours (light and dark); setup screen glow and logo follow the chosen combo; cleaner light surfaces
Smoother scrolling: removed the heavy blur layer on the animated background

history.title: Natural colours and data-safety centre
n: Natural colour system: all 13 combos retuned to calmer, analogous tones in light and dark; quieter background glow and natural status colours
Glass icons everywhere: header buttons, brand tile, stat and pulse icons, module icons and an active tab-bar tile in tinted glass; new glass app icons
iOS-style motion: press feedback, staggered page entrance, spring dialogs, frosted backdrops, quiet scrollbars, focus rings

Data-safety centre: header shield chip, warning when you close the tab or app with unbacked-up changes, one-tap backup sheet, automatic restore points, protection against overwriting newer data from another tab, persistent-storage request
Fixes: unreadable welcome banner in light mode, misaligned setup header, squeezed stat icons, header overflow at mid widths; desktop app now asks before closing with unsaved data

history.title: Command Deck, installable app and offline mode
n: Command Deck header redesign: brand tile that changes icon per page, search, module switcher, GitHub sync status, install button and New task on top; week navigator with day pips, office-day gauge, Open / Due today / Overdue tiles and a Leader-of-the-week card below. Follows every colour combo, light and dark, and phone layouts
Installable app: web manifest, offline service worker, app icons (including maskable), and an Install app button in the header
Fully offline: Excel library and fonts are now bundled in /vendor (no CDN needed)
Desktop app (Windows / macOS / Linux) via the new /desktop Electron project, plus one-click launchers that open MISphere in its own window

history.title: One colour system and Team Hub
n: One colour system: every combo is now a tonal family with a readable text colour; buttons, tab bar, switches and update pill follow the chosen combo (some stayed blue before)

Team Hub: neutral glass member cards with health status, workload meter, 6-week trend, next deadline, quick Tasks / ＋ Task actions; new leader spotlight; search, filters, sort, cards/list layout and Share summary
New member colour palette (12 balanced colours); existing members are converted automatically
Tasks: bulk select (done, in progress, priority, reassign, deadline, delete) with Undo; Quick views; Quick add (type “Report @ali fri !high 2h”); overload warning while assigning

history.title: Colour grading and transfer sheet
n: Colour grading, iOS-style transfer sheet for import/export, animated tab-bar indicator

history.title: Sections, View bar and motion
n: Defined sections, View bar, Board settings and a stronger motion layer

history.title: System health and daily backups
n: System health panel: storage, data integrity checks, backups and one-tap restore points
Daily automatic backup (last 5 restore points kept)
iOS-style notification banners, launch splash, offline/online alerts
Keyboard shortcuts sheet (press ?)

history.title: Team card polish
n: Team cards: fixed clipped avatar/badge overflow, rebuilt the leader switch, rank shown inline, quieter empty states (– instead of 0%), dimmed zero stats, tooltips for long names, refined leader card tiles

history.title: Colour combos and safer updates
n: Colour combos: Ocean, Aurora, Sunset, Forest, Graphite with an animated colour-mesh background
Liquid-glass upgrade: edge bevel highlights, cursor-following shine, adjustable glass intensity (Soft / Standard / Strong)
Update history timeline with install dates; Update available pill in the header
Safer updates: verification step, failure screen, automatic recovery offer after a faulty session, background update checks

history.title: Team cards v2 and module manager
n: Team cards rebuilt from scratch: progress-ring avatar, large completion figure, status bar and stat tiles
Module manager in Settings: create, edit, rename, recolour, focus and delete modules with live task counts
Quick plus button beside the module selector for instant module creation

history.title: Glass team cards
n: Team cards redesigned: transparent glass with member-colour tint, glow and refined stats

history.title: iOS design system
n: iOS design system: SF-style typography, system colours, large titles, switches and sheets
Glitch fixes: no re-render flicker, lighter blur for smoother scrolling, no input zoom on iPhone
Smoother spring animations on page change and dialogs

history.title: Software Update sheet
n: iOS-style Software Update sheet with progress and What's New
Smoother spring animations

history.title: Liquid glass and one-click update
n: Stronger liquid-glass UI and smoother animations
One-click Update with automatic safety backup and rollback
Version history and restore points in Settings

history.title: Modules and live GitHub sync
n: Modules, module reporting, live GitHub sync
